description: An expander for Modal Filter that adds five more resonator voices, each tuned away from that filter's own frequency; it goes immediately to the right of the Modal Filter it belongs to

params.text: Switches the five voice knobs between reading as semitones and reading as hertz
Tunes its voice away from the Modal Filter's frequency, by up to 24 semitones either way when the switch is set to semitones, or by up to 500Hz either way when it is set to hertz
Silences its voice while it is on, and lights while it is

inputs.text: Moves its voice's offset, added to that voice's knob, with 5V covering the whole of the knob's travel

notes: this module does nothing on its own; it has to be placed immediately to the right of a Modal Filter, and its five voices are then added to that module's resonator bank
the display reads the Modal Filter's current frequency as a note name, a frequency in hertz and an offset in cents, and reads NOT CONNECTED when there is no Modal Filter beside it
